dashboardSelectPortHint: Select a port from the header to load dashboard data.
jettyLiveNoPermission: You do not have permission to view Jetty Live CCTV. Ask an admin to enable View Jetty Live stream under At-Berth Executions in Role Management.
jettyLiveHealthUnreachable: Cannot reach stream health API. Is the RTSP helper running?
jettyLiveHealthUnreachableBanner: Stream helper is not running — video cannot start.
jettyLiveHealthUnreachableDevHint: From the repo root, run npm run dev:stream in a separate terminal (or npm run dev:jetty-live to start stream + UI together). Requires FFmpeg on PATH and network/VPN access to the camera RTSP URL.
jettyLiveProxyHint: Using dev proxy (/jetty-live-stream → stream HTTP, /jetty-live-ws → MPEG WebSocket). Ensure rtsp-stream-viewer is on ports 3080 / 9999.
jettyLiveNoCameraUrl: No camera URL in this link. Configure an RTSP link in Master – Jetty, or open Jetty Live from the allocation schematic.
jettySchematicNoCctv: There's no CCTV on this jetty
jettyLiveStreamStruggling: The stream helper is running but no video frames are arriving. Check VPN/network access to the camera, confirm the RTSP URL in Master – Jetty, and try Reconnect. On the stream server host, test: ffmpeg -rtsp_transport tcp -i "<your-rtsp-url>" -t 5 -f null -
masterJettyIntro: Jetties from API (per port). Used when selecting a jetty on shipping instructions.
reportingIntro: Select a report to view. Use date range and optional vessel or jetty filters where applicable.
reportingDailyDesc: End-to-end activities from Vessel Arrived (TA) until Vessel Cast Off / Sailed. Header, timelog, and progress loading/unloading.
reportingVesselDesc: Jetty utilization, allocation by jetty, and full vessel detail for the selected port. Filter by date range and jetty.
masterIntro: Manage master data for ports, jetties, and SI dropdowns.
adminIntro: User management and RBAC: users and roles.
qualityCardLead: FFA, DOBI, IV per shipment. Compare loading quality to discharge quality.
loadingPageListIntro: Select a {{purpose}} operation to record survey, quality check, quantity check, and final checks.
loadingPurposeMismatch: This operation is <bold>{{apiPurpose}}</bold>. Open it under the correct section:
masterHubPortDesc: Add and manage master port / site data.
masterHubJettyDesc: Add and manage master jetty options per port (used when selecting a jetty on shipping instructions).
masterHubJettyLayoutDesc: Define how jetties are arranged in the Jetty Schematic for each port.
masterHubTanksDesc: Shore tanks per port for liquid Cargo Operations (source / destination tank selection).
tankFarmDesc: Latest tank gauging readings from Tankvision (read-only).
tankFarmEmpty: No mapped tanks or readings for this port. Seed tank_gauging_tank_map and run the poller.
tankFarmFooter: ATG sources: Tankvision NXA hosts listed per row · values update when the poller runs · volume shown in liters (PARAM 717 m³ × 1000)
tankFarmSourcesEmpty: No ATG sources configured for this port.
tankFarmSourcesSecretRequired: Password or cookie is required for this auth type
masterHubSiTermDesc: Add and manage trade terms (Terms) for Shipping Instructions.
masterHubSiShipperDesc: Add and manage shippers for Shipping Instructions.
masterHubSiLoadingPortDesc: Add and manage loading ports for Shipping Instructions.
masterHubSiSurveyorDesc: Add and manage surveyors for Shipping Instructions.
masterHubSiAgentDesc: Add and manage agents for Shipping Instructions.
masterHubSiCommodityDesc: Commodities for Shipping Instructions, plus standard pumping rate (MT/h) and buffer per commodity for SLA.
masterHubFreightTermsDesc: View currently fixed freight terms used by the SI module.
adminHubPartnerApiDesc: Provision and revoke API keys for external systems that submit Shipping Instructions.
adminHubNotificationsDesc: Configure SMTP, SLA email alerts, and notification recipients.
adminHubEmailLogDesc: View sent, failed, and queued notification emails.
notifAdminSmtpEnableDb: Use database SMTP settings (when disabled, environment variables apply)
notifAdminSmtpPasswordKeep: Leave blank to keep current password
notifAdminIncludePostSignoff: Include vessels after sign-off (breach alerts only)
notifAdminNoRecipients: No recipients configured (falls back to at-berth users on port).
notifAdminEmailTemplateHint: Plain-text email subject and body. Use placeholders below; they are replaced when the notification is sent.
notifAdminTemplateUnsaved: You have unsaved changes — Save to apply, or Send test email to preview your edits in your inbox.
notifAdminTemplateResetConfirm: Reset this email template to the system default?
emailLogEmpty: No email deliveries match your filters.
qualityUploadNote: Upload CPO analysis (mock): use real upload when backend is connected.
clearanceNoOperations: No operations in this queue yet. Pending sign-off appears after berth teams request sign-off; Ready to Sail after approval.
cargoOpsSubtitle: Record load segments: start and end first, then quantity (segment mass moved). When start and end are set, QTY auto-fills from ATG mass Δ across selected tanks; you can override. Last entry may omit end while in progress. Remark is free-form.
cargoOpsSubtitleShort: Time window first, then QTY. ATG reference beside quantity when tanks are selected.
cargoOpsQtyCargoInlineHint: No cargo quantity on the linked shipping instruction yet. Open the SI and enter quantity on its cargo / breakdown lines. QTY Cargo is read from the SI only, not from this form.
cargoOpsBasisMissingHint: No cargo quantity is stored on the linked shipping instruction yet. Open the SI and add cargo line(s) with quantity (breakdown). Totals here use that SI data only.
cargoOpsLineTanksRequired: Entry {{n}}: select at least one tank.
cargoOpsTanksEmpty: No tanks configured for this port
cargoOpsAtgRatePending: In progress — rate is calculated when activity End is saved (mass Δ ÷ hours from Tankvision samples).
cargoOpsAtgRateNoSamples: No ATG rate yet. Ensure the tank gauging poller has samples near Start and End, then save again with End set.
cargoOpsManualQtyHint: Quantity for tanks without ATG on this line.
cargoOpsManualQtyRequired: Entry {{n}}: manual qty is required for non-ATG tanks when end time is set.
cargoOpsLineManualQtyInvalid: Entry {{n}}: enter a positive manual quantity.
cargoOpsAtgNotAvailable: ATG not available — enter quantity manually
cargoOpsAtgUnavailableHint: No usable ATG data for this segment — tick “ATG not available” to enter the quantity.
cargoOpsAtgLockedHint: ATG is connected for this segment; the quantity comes from ATG.
cargoOpsAtgNowAvailableHint: ATG data is now available for this segment ({{qty}}). Untick to use the ATG quantity instead.
cargoOpsAtgNoSamples: no ATG samples in this window
cargoOpsLineAtgRequired: Entry {{n}}: no ATG data for this segment — tick “ATG not available” and enter the quantity.
cargoOpsLineQtyRequiredWhenEnd: Entry {{n}}: quantity is required when end time is set.
cargoOpsLineOneOpenOnly: Only one load segment may be in progress (missing end time).
cargoOpsLineOpenMustBeLast: In-progress segment must be the last entry.
cargoOpsLineAfterOpen: Close the in-progress segment before adding another entry.
cargoOpsLinesMin: Add at least one load entry with a start time.
cargoOpsLineTimeInvalid: Entry {{n}}: start or end time is invalid.
cargoOpsLineEndAfterStart: Entry {{n}}: end must be after start.
cargoOpsLineStartBeforeActivity: Entry {{n}}: start must be on or after the activity start time.
cargoOpsLineOverlap: Load segments must not overlap (next start must be on or after previous end).
cargoOpsLineStartStrict: Entry start times must be strictly increasing.
cargoOpsRateHint: Rate = this line’s quantity ÷ hours from this line’s start to end (MTPH).
cargoOpsQtyOverSiBanner: Actual quantity exceeds SI by {{delta}}{{unit}} (SI: {{siQty}} · Actual: {{total}})
cargoOpsQtyUnderSiBanner: Actual quantity is {{delta}}{{unit}} below SI (SI: {{siQty}} · Actual: {{total}})
cargoOpsQtyOverSiConfirm: Total cargo quantity ({{total}}) exceeds the Shipping Instruction quantity ({{siQty}}) by {{delta}}. Save anyway?
cargoOpsQtyUnderSiConfirm: Total cargo quantity ({{total}}) is {{delta}} below the Shipping Instruction quantity ({{siQty}}). Save anyway?
cargoHourlyMovedSignHint: Unloading: + = progress (mass up). − = reverse (mass down). Loading: − = progress. Near zero = flat.
cargoHourlyShowingRecent: Showing last {{shown}} of {{total}} clock hours · Started {{start}}
cargoOpsMovedInvalid: Enter a positive quantity for this segment.
cargoOpsSessionAdvancedEmpty: No load segments yet — use Start transfer above, or add entries here for backfill.
cargoOpsSessionAllAtgHint: All selected tanks have ATG — quantity will be tracked automatically.
cargoOpsSessionMixedHint: Some tanks have no ATG — you will enter manual quantity when completing.
cargoOpsSessionEndOnComplete: End time is set when you complete the transfer
cargoScheduleLegend: Bar = cargo moved (ATG) · tick = time elapsed (Hose-On → ETC)
cargoScheduleTooltip: Actual {{actual}}% vs planned {{planned}}% (−{{gap}}% behind). Planned is time-based (Hose-On → ETC); actual is cargo moved (ATG).
cargoScheduleBehindAria: Behind schedule: actual {{actual}} percent, planned {{planned}} percent, {{gap}} percent behind
executionsLogCargoGroupHint: {{count}} saved load segments — expand to see each entry.
